why.headline: Why?
why.description_top: With Shrink Me, you can reduce the sizes of your images and PDF files without experiencing any loss in visual quality, thereby making your sites and apps faster for your users.
why.description_bottom: As the following two images show, it is almost impossible for the human eye to find any visual distinctions.

what.headline: What?
what.description: What really makes Shrink Me stand out, is that the service has: no Ads, is Free, is Fast and works Offline.
what.no_ads_description: I believe in beautiful apps without any ads.
what.no_ads_image_alt: Forbidden icon: A red circle with a diagonal line across it, symbolizing the prohibition of ads.
what.free_description: Free to use for everyone. Compress as much as you like.
what.free_image_alt: Piggy bank icon: A piggy bank symbol, representing the availability of the service at no cost.
what.fast_description: It just takes a few seconds to compress your images.
what.fast_image_alt: Fast icon: A lightning bolt, symbolizing the high speed of the compression service.
what.offline_description: Shrink Me even works offline in any modern browser.
what.offline_image_alt: Wi-Fi icon: Depicting that the service works offline in any modern browser.

faq.headline: FAQs
faq.faq_description_1: I created Shrink Me in order to compress my own images and pdf files in a fun and intuitive way.
faq.faq_description_11: I also love to create new product experiences in order to extend and refresh my developer knowledge.
faq.faq_description_2: Image/PDF compression is ideal if you want to make your site/app load faster, save storage space,
faq.faq_description_22: or even when sending emails, where smaller file sizes can help improve delivery and reduce loading times for recipients.
faq.faq_headline_3: Do compressed images suffer from quality loss?
faq.faq_description_3: No, your images should look identical to the human eye.
faq.faq_description_33: You almost won't see any differences, just give it a try.
faq.faq_headline_4: What Compression Quality is used for JPG and WEBP images?
faq.faq_description_4: Shrink Me's compression quality for JPG and WEBP images is 60%.
faq.faq_description_44: In the future, you will be able to change this value.
faq.faq_headline_5: What is the maximum file size?
faq.faq_description_5: Currently there is no maximum file size limit.
faq.faq_description_55: Beware that big file sizes will take longer to compress.
faq.faq_headline_6: Can I compress multiple files at once?
faq.faq_description_6: Yes, you can shrink as many as you like at once.
faq.faq_headline_7: Why didn't my image get any smaller?
faq.faq_description_7: This may happen to images which already have been optimized.
faq.faq_description_8: If you truly enjoy using Shrink Me, please consider supporting me with a cup of coffee.
